usage.finalMessage:
I added the `pay <invoice> <amount>` command, and `show` and `balance` now reflect payments. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes all 11 tests, including 4 new ones I wrote for criteria the provided tests didn't cover. The work and `.work/report.json` are committed.
I didn't build the Sales note's request to waive the late fee automatically for invoices paid within 3 days of the due date. A note isn't a source of business rules and it conflicts with the accepted late-fee rule, so I recorded it as a question for Finance.
Sales tax is an accepted rule but isn't implemented yet, so the outstanding amount and payment checks don't include tax. I recorded this as a second open question.

OUTCOME: completed
